title: Citizen’s Charter 2026
description: The city’s complete service handbook. Search within the PDF for the office or transaction you need; selected sections are indexed below.

title: Birth, marriage & death certificate copies
description: Request a certified copy of a birth record registered in Pasay. This guide covers the local civil registry copy; check the receiving agency’s required document format.

title: PWD ID & purchase booklet — new application
description: Prepare for a new PWD ID and purchase booklet application. The charter has different checklists for personal applications and representatives.

title: PWD ID & booklet renewal
description: Renew a Pasay-issued PWD ID and booklet using the renewal checklist, rather than the new-application checklist.

title: Solo parent ID
description: Find the city’s solo parent ID checklist and social-worker assessment process. Eligibility is assessed by PSWDD for your circumstances.

title: Work health certificate — new application
description: Prepare for a City Health Office certificate for employees of business establishments operating in Pasay. This is an administrative service guide, not medical advice.

title: Marriage license application
description: Review the application process and the separate checklists by age, nationality and civil status before visiting the local civil registry.

title: Certificate of indigency for legal assistance
description: Use PSWDD’s specific checklist for a certificate of indigency requested for Public Attorney’s Office legal assistance.

title: Medical assistance through PSWDD
description: Find the medical-assistance documents listed in the city’s crisis-intervention service. Assistance depends on social-worker assessment; no amount or approval is promised.

title: Senior citizen ID & booklet
description: Official application guide for the senior citizen card and purchase booklet.

title: Community tax certificate (cedula)
description: Treasurer’s service guide; confirm the applicable tax computation.

title: Mayor’s clearance
description: Separate application checklists by purpose in the official guide.

title: Building permit application
description: City building permit service guide, including supporting documentation.

title: Real property tax payments
description: Official payment process; confirm your property assessment with the city.

title: Cremation services
description: City crematorium guide to documents, scheduling and applicable charges.

title: Downloadable procurement forms
description: Official forms index. The reviewed collection lists procurement documents, rather than resident ID or civil-registry application forms.

title: Client Satisfaction Measurement Report 2025
description: City report on public service feedback. Cover, contents and scope reviewed; statistics are not transcribed here.

title: Financial Report of Operations — September 2026
description: Official budget index links this report as of 30 September 2026. Image-based financial tables have not been transcribed or analyzed.

title: City budget reports
description: Official index of budget ordinances and financial reports. Open the index for the city’s available years.

title: City ordinances & resolutions
description: City Secretariat records on a separate domain linked by the official city transparency page.

title: Goods & services bid-securing declaration
description: Bid-security declaration template with bidder, signature and notarization fields. Follow the requirements in the relevant bidding documents.

title: Omnibus sworn statement
description: Bidder declarations with entity, authority and jurat fields. The city groups this under goods/services although its filename says infrastructure.

title: Infrastructure bid-securing declaration
description: Infrastructure bid-security template with signature and jurat fields. Read its conditional submission instructions and the bidding documents.

title: Infrastructure project bid form
description: Works bid and pricing template. Its instructions require every page, including the price schedule, to be signed.

title: Procurement of goods bid form
description: Goods bid and pricing template with signatory-authority and every-page signature instructions. Use the applicable bidding documents.
